id: Sunday Jazz - Alex Trask-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Sunday Jazz - Alex Trask
long_description:
The Rogue's regular Sunday afternoon jazz. Funky, jazzy, soulful jazz. Beer, hangs, and jazz, on a Sunday, perfect!

This week featuring local saxophonist Alex Trask and his quartet

Join us as we explore some new interpretations of familiar melodies and unheard compositions! The quartet will play songs from Alex's various projects, including a recent recording, his first album, and the recent EP 'The Lighthouse Trio'. Expect mysterious ballads, soulful blues, and exhilarating bop.

Alex Trask - Saxophone
Duncan Haynes - piano
Jacob Hurst - bass
Abey Baillie - drums

Photo by Oscar Laven
